description: SRCMF Opensees Archetype Dataset is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Dustin Cook, National Institute of Standards and Technology (nist.gov). OpenSees Archetype Model of Special Reinforced Concrete Moment Frames. The repository contains design data, Opensees and ATC 138 model data, response data from IDA using 44 ground motions from the FEMA Far Field set, eigen analysis data, and summary ATC 138 output data for a set of 24 reinforced concrete moment frame archetypes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Opensees, Special Reinforced Concrete Moment Frames, Lateral Force Resisting System, Seismic Design and Response. Published 2023-09-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
